notes.title: New Demo
notes.content:
[p]Hey Weavers,
 [/p][p]If you were watching the MIX you would have seen that [i]Echo Weaver[/i] participated in the showcase with a brand new trailer! If you missed it, don’t fret, you can watch it here![/p][previewyoutube="sAf7-yQyd28;full"][/previewyoutube][p][i]Echo Weaver[/i] demo has been re-released to include… Well, actually, I don’t think I should say. It is a metriodBRAINia after all.  Let’s just say it is completely different from the first demo. Check out the updated demo here and if you enjoy it please give us a wishlist! [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2184080/Echo_Weaver/"][/dynamiclink]
- Riv Otter[/p]
